name: GB energy supply margins
value: No current notices; last EMN 6 Oct
summary: No NESO or National Gas margin notices found in force as of 10 Nov; NESO issued a precautionary notice on 6 Oct
state: NESO issued a precautionary Electricity Margin Notice for the evening peak on 6 Oct, citing a 1,880 MW shortfall in its margin, and said there was no risk to supplies (Nation.Cymru). No Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice was found in force as of 10 Nov. NESO's early winter view of 25 Jun forecast an adequate 5.5 GW margin, with tighter days most likely in mid to late January.
for_you: No action needed. Margin notices ask generators for more capacity and do not by themselves signal power cuts; NESO publishes any notices on its website.
rubric_hit: No NESO or National Gas margin notices in force (Normal)

sources.title: Nation.Cymru — Electricity grid operator asks market for more back-up power generation
Electrical Review — Storage growth helps offset demand rise in NESO winter margin forecast

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
